2121807366090100842.en_summary: WSJ kinda misses the obvious lever here. Azure's been in Singapore since 2010, AWS and Google too. That's US-owned capacity you can shut off with one phone call. The real leak is the non-US neoclouds in Johor renting GPUs to Chinese labs.
2121807366090100842.zh_summary: 「《華爾街日報》有點錯過這裡的明顯槓桿。Azure自2010年起就在新加坡，AWS和Google也是。這是美國擁有的容量，一通電話就能關掉。真正的洩漏是柔佛州的非美國新雲端租用GPU給中國實驗室。」

2121797865135906830.en_summary: This chart displays why log scale must be used to generate measured downside target. On a linear scale the downside target is a big minus number.
2121797865135906830.zh_summary: 「這張圖顯示為何必須使用對數尺度來生成測量的下行目標。在線性尺度上下行目標是一個大負數。」

2121795793841762342.en_summary: Actually we should also look at log scale when there is a possibility of a huge downside move. The target of BTC on linear scale would be back toward zero -- perhaps that is where we are going.
2121795793841762342.zh_summary: 「其實當有巨大下行移動可能性時，我們也應該看對數尺度。BTC在線性尺度上的目標會回到零附近－也許那就是我們要去的地方。」
